title: Lotus Plasma Sphere
description: A glowing plasma globe with a central purple orb and branching electrical tendrils in yellow, cyan, and pink. Inside the transparent sphere, a female figure with long hair is partially visible on the left side, reaching toward a white lotus flower floating on dark water with lily pads.
prompt: A surreal plasma globe sculpture on a black stand, containing a glowing purple central orb emitting bright yellow, cyan, and pink branching electrical arcs. Inside the sphere, a translucent female figure with long hair reaches toward white lotus flowers floating on dark reflective water with lily pads. The background is a dreamy purple pattern with black lotus silhouettes and glowing dots, creating a mystical atmosphere.
